name: Potent Dragonmark
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Any Dragonmark Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase the spellcasting ability score used by your Dragonmark feat by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Dragonmark Preparation
features.description: You always have the spells on your Spells of the Mark list (if any) prepared.

features.name: Dragonmark Spellcasting
features.description: You have one extra spell slot to cast the spells granted by your Dragonmark feat. The spell slot’s level is half your level (round up), to a maximum of level 5. You regain the expended slot when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can use this spell slot to cast only a spell you have prepared because of your Dragonmark feat or the Dragonmark Preparation benefit of this feat.
